'''Kely Huldin''' is an Andoran weaver. He is married and has two children. He is described as a lumpy, dark-haired fellow.

He came to [[Caemlyn]] to answer Rand's amnesty. He was the second man to be tested for the channeling ability by [[Taim]]. His wife, [[Mistress Huldin]], was more than relieved when he failed.
